project_type: Multiplayer 2D MMO browser game (Phaser 4 + Next.js + Supabase)
build_system: pnpm monorepo with Turbo. Packages: game-engine, shared, database, ui, web
test_framework: Vitest across all packages. Tests in src/__tests__/ directories. Components are pure data, systems hold logic.
verification_instructions: 1) pnpm format:check 2) pnpm lint 3) pnpm build 4) pnpm test. Optionally pnpm db:verify (requires Docker).
setup_instructions: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.1/bin:$PATH". Dependencies are already installed (node_modules exists).
environment_constraints: Node v22.23.1. pnpm 10.28.1. No hosted Supabase needed for unit tests. Docker available for db:verify. All 12 locales must have parity. Files must stay under 300 lines. Prettier printWidth 88.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits with scope (game-engine, database, web, shared). No `any` types. Interface over type for object shapes. One component/class per file. ECS: components are pure data, systems hold logic. All user-visible strings are i18n keys. 12 locale parity enforced by i18n.test.ts.
key_patterns: Components extend Component with type string. Systems extend System with requiredComponents array. Request fields on components are consumed by systems next frame. HUD raises flags, systems consume them. Definitions in separate files (e.g. questDefinitions.ts). Pure ops in separate files (e.g. questOps.ts). Items defined in packages/shared/src/items.ts with ItemId union type. Prices in packages/shared/src/economy.ts. i18n messages in apps/web/src/i18n/messages/{locale}.ts with parity test.
directory_structure: packages/shared/src/ (items, economy, constants, chat, utils). packages/game-engine/src/ (ecs/, components/, systems/, world/, inventory/, quests/, collection/, fishing/, shop/, dialogue/, animation/, interaction/). apps/web/src/ (game/, i18n/, stores/, components/, __tests__/). packages/database/supabase/migrations/ (001-006 SQL).
